_how: Money put into or taken out of a paper account, so the desk never counts it as profit or loss. Put each extra on its own line between the [ and the ]: {"date": "2026-12-15", "amount": 250, "note": "bonus"}, with a comma after every entry but the last. Plain numbers in dollars; below 0 is a withdrawal. Add new extras at the end. Never edit or delete one that's already been recorded: correct it with another extra. README: Deposits and withdrawals.
